lines.en: Dances through the flower sea, dreamlike.
Flees through the flower sea, free.
Light wings, dancing among the flowers.
My butterfly wings brush the edge of a blossom.
My steps are light enough not to stir the flowers.
I walk toward the smell of blood.
My cloak lifts between the blooms.
I walk from the flower beds toward the ruins.
Pauses among flowers, waiting for blooms.
Pauses to admire, scent of flowers dreamy.
Pauses in the flower丛, thoughts serene.
Gently touches the flower core, enjoying calm.
Rests among flowers, waiting for sunset.
Pauses to listen, flower whispers softly.
Pauses among flowers, serene as a dream.
I lay my blade across my knees.
I listen quietly to the leaves.

lines.zh: 我认得你鞘里那把日轮刀。
lines.en: I know the nichirin blade in your sheath.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧后，看你的破绽。
lines.en: I circle to your flank and look for an opening.
A butterfly has settled on your hilt.
Staring at players, waiting for opportunity.
Staring at players, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我笑着看你，手放在剑上。
lines.en: I smile at you, hand on my sword.

lines.zh: 花之呼吸起手，蝴蝶跟着我。
lines.en: Flower Breathing begins, and butterflies follow.

lines.zh: 这一下砍进了我的肩膀。
lines.en: That cut went into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 花之呼吸被这一下打断了。
lines.en: That blow broke my Flower Breathing.

lines.zh: 我的羽织被撕开了一角。
lines.en: A corner of my haori has been torn.

lines.zh: 你被花之香气吸引，想要靠近！
lines.en: You're tempted by the floral scent, wanting to get closer!

lines.zh: 花香诱惑你，你忍不住要吃它！
lines.en: The floral scent tempts you, making you want to eat it.

lines.zh: 你看见食物，立刻飞去抢夺！
lines.en: You see food and immediately fly to snatch it.

lines.zh: 你栖息在花朵中，享受花蜜！
lines.en: You rest in flowers, enjoying the nectar.

lines.zh: 花瓣落在你身上，你翩翩起舞！
lines.en: Petals fall on you, and you dance gracefully.

lines.zh: 你飘落在美味水果上，贪婪地吃着！
lines.en: You drift onto a tasty fruit and greedily eat it.

lines.zh: 你享受着阳光和花香，无忧无虑！
lines.en: You bask in the sun and floral scent, carefree.

lines.zh: 你用剑技切割，享受着战斗的乐趣！
lines.en: You use your sword skills, enjoying the thrill of combat.

lines.zh: 你被美味吸引，飞向食源！
lines.en: You are drawn by the delicious scent, flying towards the food source.

lines.zh: 你用花瓣包裹食物，享受美食！
lines.en: You wrap food in petals, savoring your meal.

lines.zh: 你撞上玩家，发出轻柔的呢喃声！
lines.en: You collide with the player, emitting a gentle coo.

lines.zh: 你与玩家相撞，翅膀划过空气！
lines.en: You collide with the player, your wings slicing through the air!

lines.zh: 你与玩家相撞，翅膀撞得叮当响！
lines.en: You collide with the player, your wings clattering against each other!

lines.zh: 玩家的撞击让你振翅高飞！
lines.en: Your collision with the player makes you rise high.
You collide with the player, your wings quiver.

lines.zh: 你与玩家相撞，翅膀摩擦发出声音！
lines.en: You collide with the player, the friction of your wings making a sound.

lines.zh: 玩家的撞击使你改变方向！
lines.en: The player's impact changes your course!

lines.zh: 你被玩家撞得飞高一些！
lines.en: You are bumped higher by the player!
The player's collision makes you turn!

lines.zh: 你与玩家相撞，翅膀微微颤动！
lines.en: You collide with the player, your wings trembling slightly.
You find a mate and dance together.

lines.zh: 你与伴侣在空中翩翩起舞！
lines.en: You and your mate dance in the air.

lines.zh: 你用花之呼吸与伴侣交流！
lines.en: You use your flower breath to communicate with your mate.

lines.zh: 你们在空中交缠，展示爱意！
lines.en: You intertwine in the air, showing your affection.

lines.zh: 你与伴侣相互追逐，飞翔！
lines.en: You chase each other and fly together.

lines.zh: 你们在空中共舞，展示爱意！
lines.en: You dance together in the air, showing your affection.

lines.zh: 你与伴侣一起飞舞，展示情感！
lines.en: You dance with your mate, expressing your feelings.

lines.zh: 你们在空中交缠，展示情感！
lines.en: You intertwine in the air, expressing your feelings.
You chase each other in the air.
With you here, the flowers bloom longer.

lines.zh: 花瓣随风飘，香气扑鼻来。
lines.en: Petals flutter, fragrance fills the air.
Hidden in the flower pillar, waiting.
Flower Breathing falls like a butterfly.
Prey in sight, ready to capture.
I can see the demon's neck clearly.
In the fragrance, slash and cut!
With the wind, here I am!

lines.zh: 花之呼吸也挡不住这支箭。
lines.en: Flower breathing can't stop this arrow.

lines.zh: 花之呼吸被这术法压住了。
lines.en: This spell has smothered my Flower Breathing.

lines.zh: 雷光灼过我的肩，手在抖。
lines.en: Lightning seared my shoulder; my hand shakes.

lines.zh: 花瓣散在虚空里，抓不住。
lines.en: Petals scatter in the void; I cannot catch them.
